purpose: Classify high-value technical evidence, historical snapshots, conceptual patterns, speculative thought experiments, symbolic archives, unresolved tests, and external-review dependencies without rewriting historical artifacts.

standout_objects.reason: Operationalizes exact-match/min-entropy boundaries, blocks sandbox self-certification, preserves established-math novelty boundaries, and defines an external blinded next gate.
Composes freeze, entropy, causal isolation, multiplicity, anytime-valid statistics, freshness, quorum and fail-closed verification; composition novelty remains unestablished.
Useful cross-project evidence architecture; working interpretive name only, not an established new field.
Models stacked multi-branch proof state, exact heads, CI/artifact inventories and OPEN gates without flattening them into false theorem authority.
Strong static archive-forensics/software-archaeology pattern: deduplication, path safety, secret quarantine, non-execution, provenance and integrity ledgers.
Valuable as an anti-false-positive red-team; extraordinary historical naming is not positive evidence of precognition or retrocausality.
Well-scoped preregistration for stale/in-flight execution after disable acknowledgement; strict result is absent from the audited default branch.
Useful append-only observation/evidence-chain design inspiration; organism/self-awareness/diagnosis language is metaphorical.
Carefully bounded research-planning note with ablations, uncertainty and anti-diagnostic rules; current biological/medical claims require fresh primary-source review.

high_risk_families.policy: Speculative safety thought experiment only; not evidence for telepathy, extraterrestrial technology, mind-over-matter or precognition.
Hypothesis-generation records unless conventional definitions, controls, independent measurements and external review establish a narrower result.
Personal/symbolic archive only; timestamp coincidence and invalid symbolic times are not physical causal evidence.
Personal testimony, theology, ethics or creative narrative; no scientific authority.
Scheduler/reliability observations may be technically useful; names and negative timestamp offsets do not establish backward causation.
Historical SAT heuristic/proof-search material only; no asymptotic complexity result; current P vs NP status remains OPEN.
